prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” lawyer for every Houston car-wreck case. For a starting point, **Brian White** and **Terry Bryant** are two Houston attorneys whose firms report that they handle car-accident cases and that the attorneys are board-certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. That credential is worth checking, but it doesn’t guarantee a particular result.

Before hiring anyone, speak with two or three firms and ask:
- Who will personally handle my case?
- Have you handled crashes like mine, and what were the outcomes?
- What is the contingency fee, and who pays case expenses?
- Will you take the case to trial if needed?

You can also request a referral from the **Houston Lawyer Referral Service** at **800-289-4577**. Sources: [Brian White Law](https://attorneybrianwhite.com/), [Terry Bryant](https://www.terrybryant.com/), [State Bar of Texas referral services](https://www.texasbar.com/Content/NavigationMenu/ForThePublic/DoYouNeedaLawyer/CertifiedLawyerReferralServices1/default.htm).
